subject.title: fix(tts): allow trusted local media in message_tool_only mode

question: Should `message_tool_only` allow every runtime-marked `trustedLocalMedia` payload through as stripped media-only content, or should the exception be narrowed to TTS-specific provenance?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but choosing which agent-generated local media may cross automatic room-event suppression defines a delivery and privacy boundary that repository history and tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept the generic trust rule
options.body: Treat the internal `trustedLocalMedia` marker as sufficient provenance for stripped media-only delivery, retaining the current tests and guards.

options.title: Narrow to TTS provenance
options.body: Require a TTS-specific runtime provenance marker or capability before bypassing suppression, leaving other trusted tool media private.

options.title: Keep suppression absolute
options.body: Decline automatic trusted-media delivery in `message_tool_only` rooms and retain explicit message-tool sends as the only visible path.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic trust rule
recommendation.body: Treat the internal `trustedLocalMedia` marker as sufficient provenance for stripped media-only delivery, retaining the current tests and guards.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the recently internalized agent runtime and the shared reply-dispatch policy rather than a single channel adapter.
